For a first-timer like me, what's the safest, easiest choice?
For a first-time choice, start with a rug suited to your room size, furniture layout, material, construction, and care needs. Use a rug pad with every rug to prevent slipping, add comfort, protect flooring, and extend rug life. Choose a pad about 1 inch smaller on every side; most can be trimmed.
Plush: Textured felt, non-slip rubber waffle backing; supportive and insulating for vintage, handmade, low- or no-pile rugs, flatweaves, and runners.
Luxury Grip: Cushioned vinyl with open-weave airflow and easier vacuuming; hard surfaces only.
Premium Felted: Thicker felt with non-slip backing; best for medium- and high-pile rugs, including hand-tufted styles and Moroccan shags.
Outdoor: Polymer-coated polyester; open weave promotes faster drying and helps prevent mold and mildew; suitable for any outdoor rug.
